lines.t: Oh, oh, oh, oh, oh, oh, oh, oh, oh, oh, oh, oh, oh, oh, oh, oh, oh, oh, oh, oh, oh, oh
White horse burning through the dawn
Bow stretched tight in trembling hands
The seals are breaking, skies unmade
Voices rise through smoke and flame Calling out the ancient name
Ride, ride, the horsemen ride Echoes of the end collide
War and famine, death and pride Heaven quakes, the truth denied
Ride, ride, across the void Seven seals now destroyed
Destroyed from the lamb, the scroll was torn, the final dawn reborn
Red horse brings the river's roar Peace departs the drums of war
Black horse weighs the world in chains Bread for blood, the hunger reigns
Pale horse rising, ghostly pale Death in the pit, tip the scale
How long, oh Lord, till justice nigh?
Every moon bleeds in the tide
Sealed by seal, the world is torn
Sealed by seal, the world is torn
Then heaven falls to sacred hush
Before the storm, no breath, no rush
The earth awaits its final day
Ash and gold drift through the air
Every heart laid bare in prayer
Sum the throne, the storm begins
Yep, it's call for echo now
Thus the seals give birth to the end
